owner.name: Agon Aliu
owner.subtitle: Products built at Silicode
owner.title: Agon Aliu | Silicode
owner.description: An explorable keyboard on a terrace above the Santorini caldera, with a small street running through it. Seven glowing keys open the products Agon Aliu has built at Silicode.

intro.line: Seven glowing keys, and a small street above the caldera.

projects.name: Silicode
projects.lede: A two-country software studio that ships its own products.
body: Silicode is registered in Kosovo and Switzerland. It builds AI-powered SaaS and takes on contract work, and every other glowing key on this board came out of it.

The background is finance, not computer science: advisory work at Deloitte and KPMG, ProCredit Bank and the Central Bank of Kosovo, and an MBA. That is why most of these products start from a spreadsheet problem rather than a framework.

projects.name: 2peek
projects.lede: Decode any website’s brand identity in seconds.
body: Paste a URL and get the branding back, broken out: colours, fonts, logos, spacing and components. It is the job you would otherwise do by hand with dev tools open and a scratch file full of hex codes.

projects.name: revaluatR
projects.lede: What a German commercial building is worth, and why.
body: Institutional-grade valuation for German commercial real estate. It began life as a Deloitte Excel model and is now a working product: FastAPI and PostgreSQL underneath, React on top, Stripe at the gate and a report at the end.
One valuation, one price. The waitlist is open.

projects.name: Trezio
projects.lede: Everything you meant to come back to, in one place.
body: Links, notes, screenshots and voice memos, with the voice ones transcribed automatically. AI writes the summaries and applies the tags, so what you save stays findable instead of rotting in a folder called “read later”.
An encrypted password vault, public sharing and Google Drive sync sit alongside. There is a free plan, and it does not ask for a card.

projects.name: Orbitale
body: Explore the Solar System, step inside the ISS, and watch the origins of our world unfold. It grew out of a solar-system teaching app and became something wider.
React Three Fiber and TypeScript, Zustand for state, custom shaders and a cinematic opening, written in English and Albanian so it works in a Kosovar classroom.

projects.name: OpenPaga
projects.lede: Payroll in Kosovo, from Excel to autopilot.
body: Payroll, Trust, ATK filing, payslips and bank exports in one monthly flow. It produces the exact XML the Kosovo Tax Administration expects, so an EDI declaration is a download rather than an afternoon.
Pricing is flat per company, not per employee: free up to three people, €31 a month up to ten.

projects.name: StackNest
projects.lede: A living record of everything shipped.
body: The working archive of products built through Silicode, kept across five strands: knowledge, operations, decisions, WebGL and energy. It sits on the home key, which felt right.
